milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the jukebox at spawn-relative (4, 1, 5) and face toward it, modeling that the player can see the jukebox. max_distance=10 (reduced from 16 per CommonSenseAgent's recommendation) requires the agent to actually approach the building rather than just spawning and looking in the right direction. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the jukebox.
